'''Blood Stalker''' was a [[Pantran whitefang]] living on [[Hoth/Legends|Hothduring]] the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] it was captured by ex-[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Terror Brigade]] and used as a challenge in their [[Onslaught (Terror Brigade)|Onslaught]] challenge. Blood Stalker was killed by Republic forces seeking to claim from the Terror Brigade Imperial Moff [[Yoren]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blood Stalker appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the bosses in the heroic quest "The Terror Brigade."
